'''Dyrla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When Dyrla was young, his mother was [[Death/Legends|killed]] after her [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was destroyed by the [[Thaereian military]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when Dyrla was 12 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, he and his sister [[Taan (Human)|Taan]] attended a [[Cularin Militia]] parade on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
